resources.string: Enter the sign-in code your admin gave you.
8 characters. Upper or lower case, spaces and dashes all fine.
The code lasts an hour and works once. If it stops working, ask your admin for a new one — it is one click for them.
Hold your phone to the tag by the entrance to start.
Hold your phone to the tag again to finish.
Finished your open shift at %1$s and started at %2$s. Confirm when you actually left %1$s — it will not count until you do.

resources.string: These shifts were closed automatically after 8 hours. Enter when you actually finished.
Hours, locations and payroll are managed by your admin on the web.
Shifts already sent stay on the server. Anything still waiting to send will be blocked until you sign back in. Signing back in needs a NEW code from your admin — the old one no longer works.
Without NFC you can\'t clock in at the tags. Tell your admin.
Turn NFC on, or the tag by the entrance will do nothing.
This app isn\'t allowed to read tags
Android has blocked NFC tag scanning for this app. While that is the case, holding your phone to the tag does nothing — and your time is not recorded.
Open the app once after installing it. Android delivers no NFC intents to an app that has never been launched.
No connection — will send when you\'re back online.
Your name is no longer on the roster. Ask your admin.
This location was removed. Ask your admin.
The server doesn\'t have this shift. Ask your admin.
Another shift is still running — finishing it first.
Finish time is before the start time.
This phone\'s clock looks wrong. Check the date and time.
This app version was rejected by the server. Update it.
You were signed out. Sign in again.
Sign-in was not accepted. Try again.
That code wasn\'t accepted. Type it again — if it still doesn\'t work, ask your admin for a new one.
No connection. Signing in needs the internet once — try again when you have it. Your code is still valid.
Too many attempts — try again shortly.
This shift is missing its location and can\'t be sent.

Rejected by the server. Report this shift to your admin.
